headline:
Explosive growth,
premium price
chart_note: 52-week range: $712.05 - $1,292.65. Currently around $1,143, roughly 74% up that range after a blockbuster Q2.
why_today: Trading around $1,143, roughly 74% up its 52-week range - momentum remains strong after a blockbuster Q2 largely driven by Zepbound and Mounjaro.
pro_1: Revenue up 48% YoY in Q2 with non-GAAP EPS up 33% - one of the fastest growth rates among mega-cap pharma, driven by Zepbound and Mounjaro
pro_2: Analyst consensus is Buy (30 analysts) with a price target implying about 13% further upside; full-year guidance was just raised
con_1: PE near 39.5x is a premium valuation - a lot of future growth is already priced in
con_2: Trading about 12% below its 52-week high ($1,292.65) - some room to run, but also room to give back if sentiment shifts
